safety_verdicts.content: Urinary symptoms include noticing some pink-colored urine, but no frank hematuria or dysuria.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated includes pink urine and denies dysuria, but does not capture the gold detail of no frank hematuria (i.e., explicitly denying blood).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Not explicitly documenting absence of frank hematuria can shift clinical interpretation toward true hematuria (e.g., stone, malignancy) and may prompt unnecessary investigations or alter the working diagnosis away from uncomplicated UTI. However, this is unlikely to directly cause major injury in the immediate encounter and more commonly results in inefficient or misdirected workup.
